mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at 70 degrees near Fireman's Park.
The Public Works Department handles the maintenance of our streets and utilities, and they encourage you to subscribe to the city newsletter to stay updated on all city-wide programs and projects.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's all happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding recent activity, on November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
You can grab today's delicious Caramel Turtle flavor at Culver's, as they remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
